sessions.topic: Test a fixed probe-error gate with scratch fallback and diagnose its shortcomings
sessions.boundary_reason: The fixed-gate benchmark and fallback ablation conclude; the next discussion turns to mixed shifts.

sessions.topic: Test option-level gating when grasp dynamics remain compatible but placement dynamics change
sessions.boundary_reason: The mixed-shift trials produce results and a dataset; the next proposal develops calibrated gating.

sessions.topic: Evaluate calibrated option gates, diagnose held-out deficits, and prioritize gate calibration
sessions.boundary_reason: The diagnosis leads to fitting per-option conformal gates; the next discussion tests their performance.

sessions.topic: Benchmark conformal compatibility gates against scratch and the fixed gate
sessions.boundary_reason: The conformal-gate benchmark concludes; the next proposal explores value-based transfer gating.

sessions.topic: Assess whether 200 contact probes support safe pessimistic skill-value gating
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial evaluations reveal differing useful-skill retention; the next discussion investigates why.

sessions.topic: Investigate intermittent-slip probes as a cause of low useful-skill retention
sessions.boundary_reason: Slip-enriched probing explains and improves retention; the next proposal uses adaptive sampling.

sessions.topic: Benchmark adaptive slip probing and prepare held-out manipulation tests
sessions.boundary_reason: The benchmark and held-out test artifact are complete; the next discussion audits probe efficiency.

sessions.topic: Audit adaptive probing for rare-slip detection and wasted compatible-target probes
sessions.boundary_reason: The audits find that adaptive probing misses its detection and probe-count targets; the next discussion tests a different trigger.

sessions.topic: Test and adopt conformal uncertainty-triggered slip probes
sessions.boundary_reason: The trigger meets both probe targets and a decision is made; the next proposal integrates it with option gating.

sessions.topic: Evaluate probe-inclusive combined gating and select it over adaptive-only gating
sessions.boundary_reason: Probe-inclusive benchmarks and the matched comparison support a selection; the next work validates new shifts.

sessions.topic: Prepare probe-inclusive validation on payload and gripper-delay shifts
